overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: a single member's email to the complainant was not deliberation, and the Commission's account that it deliberated at a noticed July 11 meeting was credited.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission deliberated outside a posted meeting when a single member's October 14 email declined to reopen her Wetland Protection Act complaint.
allegations.key_passage: does not constitute deliberation, which is defined in the Open Meeting Law, in part, as communication “between or among a quorum of a public body” and does not include communications to non-public body members.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged unspecified earlier deliberation among Commission members before the October 14 email; she gave no dates or participants.

note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
